source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseDeterministicMockRequiredMetadata001Test { private class CallbackProbe implements Metadata.DeployCallback { public void handleResult(Metadata.DeployResult result, Metadata.DeployCallbackContext context) { System.assertNotEquals(null, context); } } @isTest static void metadata001Witness() { Metadata.CustomMetadata custom = new Metadata.CustomMetadata(); custom.description = 'Feature description'; custom.fullName = 'Feature.Default'; custom.label = 'Feature'; custom.protected_x = true; Metadata.CustomMetadataValue value = new Metadata.CustomMetadataValue(); value.field = 'Enabled__c'; value.value = true; custom.values = new List<Metadata.CustomMetadataValue>{value}; System.assertEquals('Feature', custom.label); System.assertEquals('Enabled__c', custom.values[0].field); System.assertEquals(true, custom.values[0].value); Metadata.CustomObject objectDef = new Metadata.CustomObject(); objectDef.deploymentStatus = 'Deployed'; objectDef.description = 'Object description'; objectDef.enableActivities = true; objectDef.enableReports = true; objectDef.fullName = 'Fixture__c'; objectDef.label = 'Fixture'; objectDef.pluralLabel = 'Fixtures'; System.assertEquals('Fixture__c', objectDef.fullName); System.assertEquals(true, objectDef.enableActivities); System.assertEquals(true, objectDef.enableReports); Metadata.DeployCallback callback = new CallbackProbe(); Metadata.DeployCallbackContext context = new Metadata.DeployCallbackContext(); System.assertEquals(null, context.getCallbackJobId()); Metadata.DeployContainer container = new Metadata.DeployContainer(); container.addMetadata(objectDef); System.assertEquals(1, container.getMetadata().size()); System.assertEquals(true, container.removeMetadata(objectDef)); container.addMetadata(custom); System.assertEquals(true, container.removeMetadataByFullName('Feature.Default')); Metadata.DeployMessage message = new Metadata.DeployMessage(); message.id = '0Af000000000001AAA'; message.problemType = Metadata.DeployProblemType.Info; System.assertEquals('0Af000000000001AAA', message.id); System.assertEquals(Metadata.DeployProblemType.Info, message.problemType); System.assertNotEquals(null, callback); } }
